policy: category-only; no private input filenames, sizes, hashes, or reads
categories: All nonallowlisted runtime data, raw/private inputs/results/logs, credentials, contacts, token URLs, auth/session/storage data and private failure references.
Original Doctor log includes an actual private diagnostics path: excluded without a raw hash; the labeled clone omits only that path value.
Publication scratch and its unsuccessful tooling attempts remain ignored. No private image was inspected and no archived harness was executed.
runtimePolicy: Only the exact 74 paths in runtime/public-allowlist.json, including its one artifact-hashes.json; never recursive runtime copying.
